1.w: A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, You have been a dwelling place for us, in generation and generation.

2.w: In the [time] before the mountains were brought forth, or You formed the earth and the world, and from forever even to forever, You [are] God.

3.w: You return man to dust and say, “Return, O sons of men!”

4.w: For a thousand years in your eyes [are] like a day past that passes, or a watch in the night.

5.w: You sweep them away; they are in their sleep like the grass that sprouts up in the morning.

6.w: In the morning it blossoms and flourishes; in the evening it is cut down and withers.

7.w: For we are consumed by Your anger, and by Your wrath we are terrified.

8.w: You have set our iniquities before You, our hidden [things] in the light of Your face.

9.w: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years as a sigh.

10.w: The days of our years, in them [are] seventy years, or if by strength eighty years; yet their pride [is] toil and trouble—for it is cut off soon, and we fly away.

11.w: Who knows the power of Your anger, for as the fear of You [is] Your wrath?

12.w: So teach [us] to number our days, that we may bring in a heart of wisdom.

13.w: Turn back, O YHWH—until when?—And have compassion on Your servants!

14.w: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad in all our days.

15.w: Let us be glad according to the days You have afflicted us—the years we have seen evil.

16.w: Let Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor upon their sons.

17.w: And may the favor of YHWH our God come to be upon us, and may You support the work of our hands upon us—and the work of our hands establish!
